verdict.rationale: Superhuman lets users write short AI prompts for custom Auto Labels that classify mail as it arrives, and those labels can drive split-inbox tabs. Auto Archive and the email assistant also act automatically on incoming mail (labeling, archiving, drafting, follow-up reminders). The what's-new page separately claims agents that "run proactively based on triggers you set" via chat or a visual builder, but that is a single thin line and it is unclear whether it covers Mail. Missing for 10: a documented general rule builder mapping user-defined conditions to arbitrary actions (beyond labeling or preset archive behavior), detail on which event triggers and actions the agent builder supports in Mail, availability of custom Auto Labels beyond Business/Enterprise plans, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
